name: elm-tests
description: Dev/test tooling only — the app itself (../index.html) has no build step and never depends on this package.json or node_modules. Lives here, one level under the repo root, rather than at the root itself, because Tauri's frontendDist points at the whole repo and hard-refuses to build if node_modules is a DIRECT child of that folder — one level deeper is invisible to that check, and Node's own module resolution still finds tests/node_modules from anything under tests/**.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
